name: What does the kitchen drywall repair process involve?

mainEntity.name: What does the kitchen drywall repair process involve?

acceptedAnswer.text: Kitchen drywall repair involves cutting out damaged sections, installing new drywall backing, taping, applying joint compound in multiple thin coats, sanding smooth, and blending the texture to match the existing wall. Because kitchens have grease, steam, and high-gloss or semi-gloss paints, the area must be thoroughly degreased and primed before the final coat of paint. If the repair sits behind appliances, outlets, or upper cabinets, tradespeople must also secure the edges properly so future cabinet movement or vibration does not crack the patch.
acceptedAnswer.description: Kitchen drywall repair involves removing damaged sections, securing new drywall, taping, applying joint compound in layers, texture matching, priming, and painting.
